spec: RFC 5280 section 4.1, the outline only, over DER (X.690 section 10): one value fills the input; every element walked has a one-byte tag and a definite length in its shortest form. Certificate ::= SEQUENCE { tbsCertificate SEQUENCE, signatureAlgorithm SEQUENCE, signatureValue BIT STRING }. tbsCertificate ::= SEQUENCE { [0] EXPLICIT INTEGER (1 or 2) OPTIONAL, serialNumber INTEGER, signature SEQUENCE, issuer SEQUENCE, validity SEQUENCE { Time, Time }, subject SEQUENCE, subjectPublicKeyInfo SEQUENCE, then at most once each and in this order [1] (0x81), [2] (0x82), [3] (0xA3) }. Elements inside the names, the algorithm identifiers, the key and the extensions are not walked: they are bytes.
derived: the PEM text of the certificate
the DER followed by one byte, by itself, and by a second certificate
the DER without its last byte
each element walked with its length in a longer form, and in the indefinite form
each element walked removed, repeated, and given another tag
each Time with every text of refuseTexts and with the other time type
